name: Akemi Rivea
source:
A very handsome man and childhood friend of Zella. He recieved a rigurous training so he can be admiral of the Brunarian forces.
Because of his looks and political position, he recieved several proposals from almost every kind of young girl, from farmers daugthers to nobles and princesses from other kingdoms.
